label: Ladotyri Mytilinis
note: Ladotyri means oil cheese: after ripening it is submerged in olive oil, a preservation method common before household refrigerators. Mass-market version is called graviera.

about.text: Ladotyri Mytilinis is a hard PDO cheese from Lesbos, Greece, preserved in extra virgin olive oil. It is made from sheep milk or sheep with at most 30 % goat milk and has been produced since ancient times.

steps.note: Reheated after the curd is broken up.
Pressed in the vat into a mass.
Into pieces of 5–7 kg, then to final size.
Firmly pressed by hand in the moulds.

processing.text: Ripened in a ripening room, then stored in olive oil.
